title: Oreimo 2
native: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない。
synopsis: Kirino is back from her trip to America, but the fun doesn't stop here! In the second season of Oreimo, Kyousuke continues to give Kirino life consultations. This time, romance lurks on the horizon for both siblings...
alt_seasons: Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai TRUE ROUTE (2011)
search_text: oreimo 2 俺の妹か こんなに可愛いわけか ない tv finished

episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Come Back Home Again
episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke is concerned that bringing Kirino back from America has caused her to reverted back to her old ways.

episodes.title: The Big Brother I Trusted and Sent Off Can't Get This Addicted to a Mobile Dating Sim and Commit Sexual Harassment
episodes.synopsis: Ayase has turned to Kyousuke in help pulling Ayase from her new game. Unexpectedly, it is Kyousuke who takes the game to far.

episodes.title: My Friend Can't Take Off Her Glasses
episodes.synopsis: This is the story of Makishima Saori and Saori Bajenna.

episodes.title: My Little Sister's Rival Can't Come to Japan
episodes.synopsis: Kirino wants her former roommate, Ria, to homestay with her while she is in Japan. Kyousuke can’t understand why she is determined for her former rival to say with her.

episodes.title: I Can't Be My Little Sister's Boyfriend and My Little Sister Can't Have a Boyfriend
episodes.synopsis: Kirino is being scouted by a model agent to work abroad, in a panic she gave the excuse of having a boyfriend for her reason of not wanting to leave Japan. She now needs Kyosuke help in order the keep the lie going but things start going too far…

episodes.title: There's No Way My Sister Would Bring Her Boyfriend Home!
episodes.synopsis: While attending comiket, the group coincidentally happens on Mikagami, who turns out to be a fashion model and designer that Kirino knew from work. As the two of them start enjoying a friendly otaku conversation, Kyousuke wonders about their relationship.

episodes.title: I Can't Become A Couple With My Underclassman
episodes.synopsis: Unable to give Kuroneko an answer when she tells him she has feelings for him, Kyousuke asks for a day to think it over. On the way home from the Comiket closing party, Kyousuke stands in front of Kuroneko and gives his answer…

episodes.title: I Can't Create a Summer Memory with My Underclassman
episodes.synopsis: Kyousuke was elated to be going out with Kuroneko. And Kuroneko felt the same way. The pair enjoyed being a couple, though dating was new to both of them. On one such date, Kuroneko suddenly pulls out a notebook. In it is written...

episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Be This Cute!
episodes.synopsis: After the fireworks show, Kyousuke is unable to reach Kuroneko. He goes to school where he learns that Kuroneko has transferred to another school. That night, unable to accept this reality, a dejected Kyousuke offers Kirino some life counseling.

episodes.title: My Little Sister Can't Wear a Wedding Dress
episodes.synopsis: Learning that Kyousuke and Kuroneko are dating, Ayase questions Kyousuke about it. A few days later, Ayase gets a call from Manami and is told that Kyousuke and Kuroneko broke up. Convinced that the breakup was her fault, Ayase calls Kyousuke, and then…

episodes.title: Little Sisters Can't Barge In On Their Brother Who Lives Alone
episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke’s mother, Yoshino, is highly suspicious of the relationship between Kyosuke and Kirino. Their father, Daisuke, orders Kyousuke to live on his own and focus on his studies until he gets an A on his next mock college entrance exam.

episodes.title: Total Angel Ayase-tan Can't Descend Upon My Place Where I Live Alone
episodes.synopsis: At Manami's suggestion, everyone is invited to Kyousuke's new apartment for a moving-in party. All of Kyousuke's usual friends are gathering at his new place on the day of the party when Kirino arrives and she's forced to confront Manami…

episodes.title: Little Sisters Can't Fall in Love With Their Older Brothers!
episodes.synopsis: Going back 8 years ago...When Kyousuke comes home, Kirino comes running to him in tears. When she holds out a broken doll between her hands, Kyousuke gives her a confident smile and starts fixing the doll. Kirino watches with anxiety, but he easily fixes.
